criteria: 能判断变形后不等号是否要改向
能用性质比较两个数的大小
set.description: 会用不等式的基本性质：两边加同一个数、乘正数方向不变，乘负数方向改变。
set.name: Properties of Inequalities

set.reason: The formula-based evaluation criterion substitutes the independent-variable value into an algebraic expression.
set.scope: computing values from analytic formulas

set.reason: The function value is the output assigned to a particular input, using the unique-correspondence definition.
set.scope: meaning of function value and its inverse lookup

set.reason: Knowing that the vertex is (h,k) supports reading the maximum or minimum from vertex form. The extremum can also be argued algebraically, which keeps this short of a strict requirement.
set.scope: reading extrema from vertex form

set.reason: The source starts from vertex form; general-form completion is avoidable for interval extrema.
set.scope: extrema from supplied vertex form

set.reason: Subtracting the same real quantity preserves order, giving exactly the sign-of-difference criterion. This requires the common-addend order property, not mastery of all negative-multiplier transformations.
set.scope: Translating A>B into the equivalent difference condition A-B>0

set.reason: Monotonicity is a useful route to endpoint and vertex comparisons. A direct squared-distance argument determines extrema without the formal monotonicity procedure.
set.scope: Determining a quadratic range from vertex position and an input interval

set.reason: Comparing endpoint/vertex values is the stated restricted quadratic-extremum procedure.
set.scope: Vertex values and restricted-interval quadratic extrema

criteria: 能由顶点式求最值
能处理限定区间的最值
set.description: 利用顶点求二次函数的最大值或最小值，注意自变量取值范围。
set.name: Maximum and Minimum Values of Quadratic Functions

criteria: 能正确代入求值
能由函数值反求自变量
set.description: 给定自变量的值，代入函数关系求对应的函数值。
set.name: Function Values

criteria: 能比较端点和顶点的函数值
能指出最值在哪一点取到
set.description: 能求二次函数在闭区间上的最大、最小值。
set.name: Maxima and minima of functions

criteria: 能正确计算两式的差
能由差的正负得出大小
set.description: 会把两个式子作差，用差的符号判断大小。
set.name: Comparing Values by Subtraction

criteria: 能画图并说出开口、顶点、对称轴
能比较函数值大小
set.description: 抛物线 y=ax² 顶点在原点，对称轴为 y 轴，a 的符号决定开口方向，|a| 决定开口大小。
set.name: The Graph and Properties of \(y=ax^2\)

criteria: 能用符号规律判断幂的正负
能正确计算简单幂
set.description: 负数的奇次幂为负、偶次幂为正；0 的正整数次幂为 0；会计算有理数的乘方。
set.name: Calculating Powers and Sign Rules
set.nameZh: 乘方的运算与符号规律

criteria: 能写出顶点与对称轴
能说出平移方式
set.description: 抛物线 y=a(x-h)²+k 的顶点为 (h,k)，对称轴为 x=h，可由 y=ax² 平移得到。
set.name: The Graph and Translation of \(y=a(x-h)^2+k\)

criteria: 会配方化为顶点式
能说出顶点、对称轴和增减性
set.description: 通过配方化为顶点式，得出顶点坐标 (-b/2a, (4ac-b²)/4a)，并研究增减性。
set.name: Graphs and Properties of y=ax²+bx+c

criteria: 能正确代入求值
能处理负数和分数的代入
set.description: 把字母的取值代入代数式并按运算顺序计算，注意负数代入要加括号。
set.name: Evaluating algebraic expressions
